summary: Elevate your research capabilities with our Mastering NVivo & SPSS course. Learn to integrate qualitative and quantitative methods for comprehensive analysis.
lede: Mastering NVivo and SPSS shows you how to move from interview transcripts and survey data to clear, defensible research findings. You will organise and code qualitative material in NVivo, prepare and analyse quantitative datasets in SPSS, and understand how coding decisions, missing values, transformations, and statistical assumptions affect results. The course brings these skills together through a controlled mixed-methods workflow, including codebook design, thematic analysis, descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, and triangulation. You will practise using procedures such as chi-square, t-tests, ANOVA, correlation, and regression, then integrate the findings into a transparent report without overstating the evidence.
audienceIntro: NVivo and SPSS training suits professionals who collect, analyze, manage, or report qualitative and quantitative research evidence. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who need practical software capability without requiring programming experience.
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with research questions, surveys, interviews, or organizational data. No coding or programming is required for completion. TrainingCred can provide practice datasets, sample transcripts, codebook templates, data dictionaries, analysis plans, and reporting worksheets. Where software access applies, you should use a licensed installation of NVivo and IBM SPSS Statistics supplied by your organization or arranged under the delivery agreement.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
